Event Carousel

Turn a CSV of events into branded Offlyn carousels. build 22

CSV format — any column order:
Event Title, Host Name, Time, City
Let's Talk with Founders, Graysheep, 04:00 PM, DEL
Keep a header row if you like — it's detected and used to label the columns below. City can be a code (DEL, BLR, MUM) or a full name (Bengaluru, New Delhi, Mumbai); either way the code prints on the card.
